title: Declared run launched in Claude's background mode is settled UNKNOWN from the task notice; its matched, complete artifact verdict (PASS) is never applied
outcome: A declared test command whose original task ends through a Claude task notice (background mode, or any END without a usable exit code) is settled according to the documented two-route contract (docs/features/declared-test-commands.md). On the NATIVE verification route, the host waits for the original task's completion, freezes the declared artifact and takes its PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN directly. On the ORDINARY observed-check route, PASS requires an observed exit 0, so a task END without a usable exit is UNKNOWN with a named missing-exit reason, even if the artifact is a complete PASS stream. A FAIL artifact or a non-zero exit is FAIL. The row never says only 'no test verdict' when a documented rule explains it. Observed by Comovo::Opus on 2026-11-08 (observed-f16a3ee0…, and the foreground persisted-output case observed-9dce8e8e…). That ordinary-route occurrence correctly cannot PASS; this item makes the outcome and its reason accurate.
acceptance: The cause is recorded from code and this occurrence. It says why the background-task completion notice settled the row as UNKNOWN, and why the matched declared artifact verdict was not applied, including whether an uncommitted declaration is meant to block the verdict.

For a matched declared command whose original task ends through a task notice or another END without a usable exit, the native route freezes and judges the declared artifact through the existing reader (PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN as the artifact says). The ordinary route yields UNKNOWN with a named missing-exit reason for a PASS artifact, and FAIL for a FAIL artifact. No exit code is fabricated or inferred from console spill files. A real failure or an invalid artifact is never PASS on either route. Foreground runs with an observed numeric exit keep the existing exit-aware judge, unchanged.

Deterministic tests cover, on BOTH routes, a task-notice END without an exit with a valid PASS artifact, a FAIL artifact and a missing artifact, plus a foreground persisted-output result without an exit. They show the route-specific verdicts and named reasons above. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed input.

completion.summary: Declared task END preserves native artifact-only and ordinary exit-aware verdicts with honest missing-exit reasons; landed d3499b97 with exact-tree Windows and Linux FULLs passed.
